subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A new app helped people remember names, birthdays, and tasks.”?
options: Then she gave students permission to add important dates.
He thought it was not important.
The third question became the most important.
It sent reminders before important dates.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Then she gave students permission to add important dates.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「He thought it was not important.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The third question became the most important.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It sent reminders before important dates.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
